evals.name: single-file
evals.prompt: Take a look at client/src/views/Dashboard.vue and tell me if there's anything I should clean up or speed up. It feels a bit sluggish when I switch filters.
evals.expected_output: A structured report with severity-tagged findings, file/line citations, snippets, fixes, and impact estimates — focused on Dashboard.vue only.

evals.name: cross-file-reuse
evals.prompt: I keep noticing the modal components feel similar. Can you scan client/src/components/ for code we should pull into shared components or composables?
evals.expected_output: A report that emphasizes cross-file duplication — at minimum identifies the *DetailModal.vue family as candidates for a shared composable or base component, with concrete file paths and line ranges.

evals.name: whole-tree-audit
evals.prompt: Do a frontend audit of client/src — performance issues, reactivity bugs, anything that should move to a composable. Give me a prioritized list.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized report covering both views and components, with a Summary that names the top 1-3 themes, severity-ranked findings, and a Cross-file opportunities section. Should specifically catch :key="index" usages and any local filter state that bypasses useFilters.
